name: zzbd_section_handler_list_merge
description: zZbdSectionHandlerList::Merge drains a sorted source list into a sorted destination list using zZbdSectionHandler::CompareSortOrderLessThan and clears the source count.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD STL-list helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c0bd0 validates the self-merge guard, sorted comparison loop, tail-range splice, destination count increase, and source count reset.
The native smoke merges two sorted lists, including an equal-sort-order case that preserves the destination node before the source tie, and verifies source emptiness.
